incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: org=opalcraft (org_9842) detected a sustained QPS spike and token surge; p95 latency > 5s, error rate +2.3% — paging oncall katie
katie (oncall): Ack, I'm on it. Starting triage.
samir: Looking at dashboards — burst from org_9842, token/sec ~4x baseline. Requests look valid, likely replay/loop.
leo: Is this isolated? any upstream deploys?
samir: Isolated to OpalCraft, no recent infra deploys in the window. Traffic pattern is lots of long chats + attachments.
jessica: If it's attachment-heavy, we should consider disabling streaming attachments for them temporarily. Also we should think per-org override vs org-wide shed.
katie (oncall): Agreed. Plan: 1) apply emergency per-org rate override to buy time, 2) flip attachments streaming off for org_9842, 3) CS outreach. @ops-bot can you run the override?
ops-bot: Running command now:
```
admin-cli orgs set-rate --org org_9842 --limit 3000 --duration 45m --reason "emergency-rl-bump opalcraft spike"
```
ops-bot: ✅ Override applied (ovr-82433). New limit 3000 qps for 45m; rolling to edge nodes.
aliya (cs): Notifying OpalCraft account team and support channel. Sending a short template asking if they kicked off a replay job.
samir: Monitoring — within 90s of override we see p95 drop from ~5s to ~800ms, error rate decreasing. Some long tails remain on sessions with large attachments.
leo: I'll patch their flag to disable attachments streaming while we confirm. Small API call: 
```
PATCH /internal/flags/orgs/org_9842
{ "attachments_streaming": false }
```
ops-bot: Flag applied: attachments_streaming=false for org_9842 ✅
jessica: Reaching out to OpalCraft: "We've applied an emergency throughput increase and temporarily disabled streaming attachments to stabilize service — can you confirm any bulk jobs?"
katie (oncall): Good. We'll let the override run 45m and auto-revert. If traffic normalizes earlier we'll roll back sooner. Keep this thread for handoffs.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-5471 — "OpalCraft QPS spike: emergency RL override + feature toggle" assigned to katie (oncall).
katie (oncall): Leaving note for followup: capture exact request IDs for the spike, save OVERRIDE ID ov r-82433 in incident doc, and plan a short post-incident with CS + Eng. If anyone sees a regression revert the flag/override and ping here immediately. :white_check_mark:
